message: `if` is outside kapsel's shell subset and is refused: if: `if` statements are not in kapsel's shell subset yet
excerpt: if true; then echo hi; fi
help: use `cmd && then-part || else-part` only when the else part cannot mask a failure
notes: kapsel runs a small, fully parsed subset of POSIX sh; anything outside it is refused instead of guessed at (REQ-KS-010)
